conviction_note: Sum of five findings (-4.5 margin-comp arithmetic, -2.5 vinyl market inflection in the exact quarter, +2.0 unrecognised tariff refund, -1.5 nullified charter amendment, -1.0 3.4m-share unrestricted float) = -7.5, well inside the 13.79% historical median reaction; the core is that Q4 FY25's 15.8% gross margin is an outlier the June quarter almost certainly cannot lap at Q3 FY26's 12.8% run-rate margin, while three brokers still carry a $10.33 median target.

findings.finding: Q4 FY25 is a freak comp that Q4 FY26 almost certainly cannot lap: last year's June quarter did $36.0m of gross profit on $227.8m of revenue at a 15.8% gross margin (vs 11.4% the prior year and 12.5% for FY25 as a whole) and $12.2m of adjusted EBITDA, whereas Q3 FY26's gross margin was 12.8% and DOWN 80bp YoY, so AENT needs roughly $281m of June-quarter revenue (+23.5% YoY) just to hold gross profit dollars flat.
findings.why_not_priced: The 15.8% Q4 FY25 gross margin sits in a year-old press release and has never been flagged as non-recurring by anyone; if the market had done this arithmetic the three published targets (ThinkEquity, Maxim, Noble, median $10.33 against a $5.30 spot) would have been cut after the Q3 margin contraction on 2026-05-14, and they were not. There is no options market to express it and no consensus line to reset, so nothing in the tape marks a Q4 profit decline.
findings.independence: Q3 FY26 confirms the margin direction independently: gross margin 12.8% vs 13.6%, with CFO Amanda Gnecco attributing it to 'the relative contribution of certain lower-margin categories as we scaled revenue' — https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/markets-news/Motley%20Fool/1962342/aent-q3-2026-earnings-transcript/ (2026-05-14). Sell-side target evidence: https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/AENT/forecast/

findings.finding: US vinyl — AENT's largest category, $337m of FY25 revenue and $99m (+15%) in Q3 FY26 — went from growth to decline in the exact quarter being reported: Record Store Day week ended 2026-04-23 sold 1.409m vinyl units against 1.482m in RSD week 2025 (-4.9%), with independent-store vinyl down 11.6%, and Luminate's midyear report has H1 2026 vinyl up only 2.4% against AENT's +15% vinyl revenue in Jan-Mar.
findings.why_not_priced: Record Store Day is a music-trade story that never crosses into AENT's ticker coverage; the wire copy on AENT through July-August 2026 is Comic-Con and 'RSD Summer Camp' marketing, and the one AENT-specific RSD press release (2026-08-27) is promotional and quotes no units. If the market had connected a -4.9% RSD week to a distributor with ~35% vinyl revenue mix, the stock would not have run +5.45% into the print.
findings.independence: Luminate's own midyear report, a different publisher and a different dataset window, puts H1 2026 vinyl growth at 2.4% versus CDs +16% — https://luminatedata.com/blog/luminate-2026-midyear-report-trends-in-music-television-film/ (2026-07-15). Distinct document and distinct mechanism from finding 1 (revenue vs margin), though both bear on the same quarter.

findings.finding: Note 13 of the Q3 FY26 10-Q discloses that AENT is importer of record on approximately $1.5m of IEEPA tariffs paid 2025-02-04 to 2026-02-24 for which a refund may be available, and explicitly did NOT recognise a receivable at 2026-03-31 — while CBP's CAPE refund tool opened Phase 1 on 2026-04-20 and Phase 2 on 2026-06-29, both inside AENT's June quarter, making recognition in the results being printed plausible; $1.5m pre-tax is ~65% of a Q3-run-rate quarter's net income and ~12% of Q4 FY25 adjusted EBITDA, at 100% margin.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a contingency note in the back half of a 10-Q for a company with three brokers and $0.1m of daily turnover; no press release, no headline and no transcript question referenced it, and management had previously told investors on the Q1 FY26 call there were effectively 'no tariffs in music and video', so nobody is carrying a tariff line for AENT at all. If it were priced the stock would not sit 37% below its 52-week high on a name whose only cited catalyst is category growth.
findings.independence: Funko recognised a $25.4m tariff-related benefit in the same Apr-Jun 2026 calendar quarter, establishing that the refunds became recognisable in that window for consumer-goods importers — https://investor.funko.com/news-and-events/press-releases/Press-Releases/2026/Funko-Reports-Strong-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-Reiterates-Full-Year-Net-Sales-Outlook-and-Raises-Adjusted-EBITDA-Guidance/default.aspx (2026-08-06). CBP process timing: https://www.thompsonhinesmartrade.com/2026/06/cbp-confirms-june-29-2026-ieepa-tariff-refund-process-phase-2-launch/

findings.finding: The charter amendment intended to make AENT index-eligible was legally voided two weeks before this print: the Third Amended and Restated Certificate filed 2026-07-29 stripping Class E voting rights was nullified by a Certificate of Correction filed 2026-08-26 because it 'was not approved in compliance with the Second A&R Certificate', leaving the February 2023 charter operative — so the stated purpose in the July information statement (raising unrestricted float from 3.0% to 6.6% to clear Russell 3000's 5% threshold) has failed and must be redone.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an Item 5.03 8-K filed the day after the earnings-call announcement press release, with no accompanying release and no news coverage anywhere in the AENT news feed for August 2026; the company issued five promotional press releases between June and August and never mentioned it. A market that had read it would have marked down the index-inclusion optionality that the July information statement had just advertised, and would have asked about a four-week period of operating under an invalid charter.
findings.independence: The purpose and the float arithmetic come from a different filing, the DEF 14C information statement of 2026-07-07 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1823584/000149315226032242/formdef14c.htm. Note this shares a source cluster with finding 5, which uses the same DEF 14C for the float number; treat the two as one document family.

findings.finding: The true tradeable float is far smaller than any data vendor shows: the DEF 14C states that as of 2026-06-24 only 3,371,581 Class A shares — 3.0% of the 110,979,630 total shares — were held by unrestricted shareholders, against a 20-day average volume of roughly 18,000 shares (~$96k) a day, so the earnings print is effectively the only liquidity window in the quarter for anyone wanting out.
findings.why_not_priced: Screens report AENT's float as ~51m shares outstanding or ~11-25m 'float'; the company's own count of unrestricted holders is an order of magnitude smaller and appears only in an information statement mailed to holders in July. A market that knew the real float were 3.4m shares would not price this at a 14% typical print reaction — it would price it wider, and there is no options market pricing it at all.
findings.independence: None from a second source — this rests on the same DEF 14C as finding 4 and should be collapsed with it into one source cluster. Corroboration of the thinness is only the baseline's own avg_volume_20d of 18,145, which is not an independent finding.

searched_and_found_nothing: Kentucky WARN notices and layoff trackers for the Shepherdsville, KY distribution centre — nothing filed by Alliance Entertainment in 2026
Form 4 / Form 3 / SC 13D-G activity in 2026 — EDGAR shows no insider filings at all since 2025-11-10, so no Form 4 cluster either way
Whether the 2026-05-15 S-3 signals dilution — it registers only warrant-exercise and resale shares at an $11.50 strike, more than 2x spot, so it is inert
GTA VI slipping out of the window management flagged as a 'home run' — Take-Two's 2026-11-19 date is still standing, so no negative revision there
Retailer shelf-space decisions at Target / Best Buy / Walmart — every story found dates to 2023-2024 and is long since in the base

Short interest against the tiny real float — Nasdaq returned 503 and Fintel 403, and the two secondary figures found (345k vs 500k shares) contradict each other with no settlement date, so it was dropped rather than cited

Any pre-announcement, covenant amendment, going-concern language or credit-facility change since the 2025-10-01 Bank of America facility — the fixed charge coverage covenant was in compliance at 2026-03-31 and nothing since
Goodwill impairment risk — $94.1m of goodwill and $19.4m intangibles with no triggering event disclosed and no impairment in the nine months
baseline_tension: There is no option chain and therefore no skew to agree or disagree with, and the free control cuts against me — run_up_20d is -4.85%, so 'short the run-up' leans long this name — but my findings line up with the reaction history the baseline records (1 up in 5, and the exactly analogous FY print on 2025-09-10 fell 15.1% on a Q4 that grew adjusted EBITDA 481%).
